Create a modern, responsive personal landing page that will be hosted on GitHub Pages.

PROJECT PURPOSE
This is a "link-in-bio" style website for social media visitors. The goal is to direct users to one of four destinations:
1. Photo Shop / Gallery
2. Telegram Channel
3. Event Photo Orders
4. PayPal Donation Page

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Use only HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript.
- No backend required.
- No databases.
- No server-side code.
- Fully compatible with GitHub Pages static hosting.
- Generate a complete project structure:
  - index.html
  - style.css
  - script.js
  - assets/ folder for images
- Mobile-first responsive design.
- SEO optimized.
- Fast loading and lightweight.
- Accessible (WCAG-friendly).
- Cross-browser compatible.
- Include Open Graph meta tags for social media sharing.
- Include favicon support.
- Use semantic HTML elements.
- Clean and well-commented code.
- Easy to customize links and profile information.

DESIGN STYLE
- Modern and professional.
- Photography-inspired aesthetic.
- Dark theme.
- Smooth animations.
- Elegant hover effects.
- Premium look and feel.
- Mobile-friendly.
- Large call-to-action buttons.
- Card-based layout.

COLOR PALETTE
Background: #0F0F0F
Primary Text: #FFFFFF
Accent Color: #FFB300
Secondary Text: #AAAAAA

TYPOGRAPHY
- Modern sans-serif font.
- Clear visual hierarchy.
- Large heading sizes.
- Readable body text.

PAGE STRUCTURE

HEADER / HERO SECTION
- Circular profile photo.
- Name:
  [YOUR NAME]
- Subtitle:
  Photographer | Content Creator
- Short description:
  "Capturing moments, sharing stories, and creating lasting memories."

MAIN ACTION BUTTONS

Button 1:
Title: 📸 Shop & Gallery
Description: Browse and purchase photos.
Link: [SHOP_LINK]

Button 2:
Title: 📢 Join Telegram Channel
Description: News, updates, behind-the-scenes content.
Link: [TELEGRAM_LINK]

Button 3:
Title: 🎉 Order Event Photos
Description: Request or purchase photos from events.
Link: [EVENT_ORDER_LINK]

Button 4:
Title: ❤️ Support My Work
Description: Help fund future photography projects.
Link: [PAYPAL_LINK]

OPTIONAL SECTION
- Featured photos grid (3-6 images).
- Lightbox gallery.
- Lazy loading for images.

SOCIAL MEDIA SECTION
Display icons and links for:
- Telegram
- Instagram
- Facebook
- YouTube
- Other platforms (optional)

FOOTER
Text:
"Thank you for visiting and supporting my work."

Include:
- Copyright notice
- Social links
- Contact email

SEO
Include:
- Meta title
- Meta description
- Open Graph tags
- Twitter Card tags

PERFORMANCE
- Optimized images
- Minimal JavaScript
- Lighthouse score target above 90
- Lazy-loaded images
- Compressed assets

DEPLOYMENT
The project must work immediately when uploaded to a GitHub Pages repository and accessed through:
https://nohead13.github.io/nohead13.github.io/

The generated code should be production-ready and require no additional setup.
